nodes.name: Rigid-body 2D correctness demo | Wasm versus JavaScript

This correctness demo executes exactly 1,800 fixed timesteps in a fresh worker. It checks all 18,000 checkpoint position, angle, linear-velocity, and angular-velocity values, solver counters, ground contact, joints, contact penetration, energy, and settlement. Nothing is uploaded or stored.

The generated CC0 fixture contains 500 independently rotated boxes and 19 anchored distance joints. Both targets run the same rotated-AABB sweep broadphase, four-axis oriented-box SAT manifolds, normal and friction impulses with angular lever arms, torque and inertia integration, anchored joint impulses, 6 velocity iterations, 64 position iterations, strict-f32 updates, and 1e-3 iteration quantization. Rendering is separate.
